release_read.basis: US BRIUMVI $232.6M is roughly in line with the ~$234M the judges read into consensus and diluted EPS $0.35 is a hair under $0.37 (Nasdaq fallback), but the FY US BRIUMVI guide is raised to $915-920M from $890-905M, implying a Q4 of $260-265M (+12-14% q/q), and total revenue $259.9M beats $247.2M on a $19.9M licence line; the raised guide outweighs the soft quarter, sized well inside the 11.8% implied move.

call.detail: Call held at 08:30 ET this morning; no transcript or call coverage found in the time available. The pre-market ran to 65.00 and sagged to 58.50 by 09:18, which happened around/after the call.

public_reaction.summary: No time to search analyst actions or headlines before the 09:24 compile; none recorded.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 59.00 (-1.4%) vs prev close 59.825; 51 prints, 9 in the last 30m, last 09:18, not stale. Pre-market high 65.00 (+8.7%) and low 58.50: it ran up on the raised guide and then gave it all back, against a market up 0.9% (IWM +1.5%). My frozen +3.0% read sits above the pre-market, so the pre-market holds less than the release supports, but the sag after the call is evidence the market found something in it I could not read.

thesis_check.note: The short thesis (bars too high, opex) is half confirmed: EPS a touch below $0.37 and US BRIUMVI only in line; but the guide was raised and implies a steep Q4, which the thesis did not expect.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is active and not stale, so the open should sit near -1%, but the move is small and the tape swung +8.7% to -1.4% in the last hour, so the open holding under half of it is plausible; a raised guide, a rising market and a release read above the pre-market lean toward a drift back up after the open.

recommendation.reason: De short staat nu iets in de winst (premarket rond 59,00 tegen instap 60,65), maar het cijfer is per saldo niet slecht: de jaarprognose is verhoogd en de markt stijgt. De premarket schoot eerst op naar 65 en zakte daarna weg; dat kan snel weer omdraaien. Neem de winst bij de opening in plaats van tot 13:00 te wachten.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de premarket voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 58,50 met veel transacties of er verschijnen negatieve analistenreacties op het gesprek, dan is vasthouden tot 13:00 (de standaardregel) beter.
